claim_ceiling: COMPLEMENTARY VIEWS CHARACTERIZED: Dense embeddings provide citation heritage recovery (AUC 0.77-0.85 > TF-IDF 0.71-0.74) at >=137k/21yr and cross-lingual navigation (Sachverhalt cross_lang_same_branch 0.28 > 0.2) at >=2k/359 decisions. Linear hybrids (w=0.3-0.4) add cross-lingual benefit but remain below TF-IDF on jurist preference (JP 0.67 vs 0.78-0.79). True OOS JuristPref ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 factory target. TF-IDF citation hybrids = PRIMARY mode. 174k dense embeddings BLOCKED pending corpus lane (bge_/bger_ mapping, parquet 2022-2026, section extraction).
evidence_summary: Independently recomputed all key metrics from raw evidence artifacts: (1) Citation heritage 22yr: center_projected_64 AUC 0.7922 (344 pos pairs), 24yr: center_projected_64 AUC 0.7667 (730 pos pairs) — all PASS >0.75; (2) Cross-lingual full-text: cross_lang_same_branch 0.9565 at 12,570 scale, minimal >=2,000; section hierarchy: Sachverhalt 0.282, Dispositiv 0.150, Erwaegungen 0.094 (cp64) — Sachverhalt/Dispositiv PASS; (3) Weight sweep 22yr: optimal w=0.4 for cited_decisions_tfidf (JP 0.6725, LangDom 0.6539 BOTH PASS), w=0.3 for outcome_hybrid_0.5; TF-IDF baselines JP 0.784/0.789; (4) Two-mode tradeoff reproduced at all scales: TF-IDF (JP~0.78, LangDom~0.48), Dense (JP~0.43, LangDom~0.83), Hybrid (JP~0.67, LangDom~0.65); (5) True OOS JuristPref ceiling ~0.53 confirmed from v8 holdout; (6) Data blockers verified: no bge_/bger_ mapping, missing parquet 2022-2026 (29,520 decisions), section extraction not at scale. All negative results honestly represented. No leakage, benchmark gaming, or prettiness-as-quality found.
